title: SpongeCluster
description: Connected sponge clusters drain water in a growing radius
body:
# SpongeCluster

SpongeCluster makes connected sponge blocks work together. Instead of scattering sponges everywhere, place a compact cluster and the drained radius grows with the number of connected sponges.

## Features

- Connected `SPONGE` and `WET_SPONGE` blocks count as one cluster
- Radius grows from the cluster size
- Drains water in a configurable spherical or cubic area
- Dries waterlogged blocks like stairs, slabs, fences, and more
- Removes water plants that would otherwise float awkwardly
- Configurable base radius, per-sponge growth, and max radius

## Requirements

- Paper 26.1.2+
- Java 25+
